profile.subtitleJa: ヘマンはアサフ、エドトンと並ぶ歌い手として神殿の奉仕者名簿に記されています。本文は彼らの子らや兄弟たちにも触れています。
profile.summaryJa: ヘマンはアサフ、エドトンと並ぶ歌い手として神殿の奉仕者名簿に記されています。本文は彼らの子らや兄弟たちにも触れています。
profile.identityNoteJa: 本文はヘマンら歌い手と、その子ら・兄弟たちを同じ場面で別々に記しています。

wikipedia.title: Heman the Ezrahite
wikipedia.noteJa: 記事は詩篇88篇の表題にあるヘマンを扱い、レビ人の歌い手ヘマンと同一人物かは可能性として述べています。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: also the Levites who were the singers, all of them, even Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers, arrayed in fine linen, with cymbals and stringed instruments and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests sounding with trumpets);

The singers, the sons of Asaph, were in their place, according to the commandment of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the gatekeepers were at every gate. They didn’t need to depart from their service, because their brothers the Levites prepared for them.
